book.geneticsresequenced.guide.blocks.an:
The [#](ff55ff)Anti-Field Block[#]() allows you to [#](5555ff)temporarily disable certain Genes[#](). \
  \
Specifically, it disables the [Item Attraction Field](entry://genes/item_attraction_field) and [XP Attraction Field](entry://genes/xp_attraction_field) when enabled. \
  \
The [Anti-Field Orb](entry://items/anti_field_orb) functions similarly, but in item form.

The Anti-Field Block is active by default, and can be disabled with a Redstone signal. \
  \
While active, it disables affected Genes within a 25-block radius by default. This radius is configurable.

book.geneticsresequenced.guide.blocks.co:
The [#](ff55ff)Coal Generator[#]() [#](5555ff)burns furnace fuels to generate FE[#](). \
  \
Furnace fuels that burn longer produce more FE. \
  \
The amount is configurable, but defaults to 6FE/t. With this, [#](5555ff)1 Coal generates 9,600 FE[#]().
If the Coal Generator fills up with fuel burning, it [#](5555ff)pauses until it has room for more energy[#](), preventing waste!
book.geneticsresequenced.guide.blocks.de: All the blocks in the mod
book.geneticsresequenced.guide.blocks.dn:
The [#](ff55ff)DNA Decryptor[#]() uses FE to decrypt [DNA Helices](entry://items/dna_helix). \
  \
Every time DNA is decrypted, it will choose a [Gene](category://genes), based on the Entity the Helix came from. \
  \
This Gene is weighted, some Genes have a higher chance than others. The Gene is chosen at the start of the process.
If the Decryptor isn't working and there's a DNA Helix in the output slot, try taking it out. The next Gene may be of a different type, which means it can't stack with the one in the output slot.
The [#](ff55ff)DNA Extractor[#]() converts Cells and GMO Cells into DNA Helices. Regular Cells keep their entity type but have an unknown Gene; GMO Cells keep their known Gene.
book.geneticsresequenced.guide.blocks.in: The [#](ff55ff)Incubator[#]() uses FE for brewing and special genetic recipes. Its top ingredient is shared across three bottom slots, allowing up to three items per operation.
It also accepts normal Brewing Stand recipes. Its speed can be increased with [Overclockers](entry://items/overclocker).

The [#](ff55ff)Advanced Incubator[#]() is an upgrade to the [Incubator](entry://blocks/incubator). \
  \
Like the Incubator, it functions as a Brewing Stand. However, the Advanced Incubator has a [#](5555ff)temperature[#]() mechanic. \
  \
The coil on the left of the GUI can be clicked to toggle between low and high temperatures.

By default, it's [#](ff5555)120 times slower[#]() at low-temperature. This means a single brew takes a full 20 minutes, excluding Overclockers. \
  \
The reason you'd want to use low temperature mode is that is the only way you can get [Genetically Modified Cells](entry://items/potion_of_cell_growth#2).

[Genetically Modified Cells](entry://items/potion_of_cell_growth#2) are [#](5555ff)guaranteed to have a specific Gene[#](), if crafted correctly. \
  \
Each GM Cell has its own recipe, with a [#](ff5555)chance of failure[#](). \
  \
The recipe for this GM Cell, for example, has a 30% chance of success, by default.

Each Overclocker [#](ff5555)decreases the chance by 10%[#](). \
  \
However, you can insert [#](5555ff)Chorus Fruit[#]() into the top right slot to increase your odds! \
  \
By default, each Chorus Fruit increases the chance by 10%. The Advanced Incubator will up as many Chorus Fruit as it takes to reach 100%.
book.geneticsresequenced.guide.blocks.pl:
The [#](ff55ff)Plasmid Infuser[#]() uses FE to infuse [DNA Helices](entry://items/dna_helix) into a [Plasmid](entry://items/plasmid). \
  \
Insert an empty Plasmid in the right slot, and a DNA Helix in the left slot. \
  \
The DNA Helix will be used up, and set the Plasmid's Gene to match the Helix's.

Each Gene requires a certain amount of [#](5555ff)DNA Points[#]() for the Plasmid to be completed.  \
- Basic Genes are worth 1 point.
- Genes of the Plasmid's type are worth 2 points.
 \
  \
A Basic Gene cannot be the first one infused into a Plasmid.

The [#](ff55ff)Plasmid Injector[#]() uses FE to inject completed [Plasmids](entry://items/plasmid) into a [Syringe](entry://items/syringe). \
  \
You can inject as many Plasmids into a single Syringe as you want.

The Syringe must be full of uncontaminated blood. \
  \
Decontaminate blood in the [Blood Purifier](entry://blocks/blood_purifier).

book.geneticsresequenced.guide.genes/pla:
The [#](ff55ff)Black Death[#]() Gene [#](ff5555)instantly kills whoever has it[#](). \
  \
Given the strength of this Gene, it's much harder to acquire than the other plagues.

To craft this DNA Helix, you'll have to get a full Syringe that has [#](ff5555)**every other negative Gene**[#]() in the game. This includes all the other plagues, but excludes any disabled Genes. \
  \
From there, simply brew that Syringe into a Potion of Viral Agents.
By default, combine Viral Agents with every enabled negative Gene in an Incubator.
Plagues are a special type of negative Gene that [#](ff5555)kills[#]() the host.
The [#](ff55ff)Gray Death[#]() Gene [#](ff5555)kills any mob that can age[#]().
By default, brew Viral Agents with a Resistance DNA Helix in an Incubator.
By default, brew Viral Agents with a Scare Creepers DNA Helix in an Incubator.
By default, brew Viral Agents with a Scare Skeletons or Scare Zombies DNA Helix in an Incubator.
By default, brew Viral Agents with a Dragon Breath DNA Helix in an Incubator.
book.geneticsresequenced.guide.intro.des: An introduction to the mod, and instructions on how to get started.
book.geneticsresequenced.guide.intro.gen:
[#](ff55ff)Genes[#]() can be taken from mobs to [#](5555ff)harness their abilities[#](). \
  \
For example, Sheep have the [Wooly](entry://genes/wooly) Gene. If you inject this into yourself, you will be able to be sheared for wool! \
  \
To see a full list of Genes, [see here](category://genes).

Each Gene page in the book will say what the Gene does. As for how to get it, the mod has [EMI](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/emi) integration. \
  \
Some Genes can even be given to mobs!
Getting Genes is a rather involved process.

First, you'll need the [Scraper](entry://items/scraper). This tool can be used on entities to collect [Organic Matter](entry://items/organic_matter) from them. \
  \
The Organic Matter will have the entity's type attached. This is what decides what Genes you can get from it.

Craft a [Cell Analyzer](entry://blocks/cell_analyzer), and process the Organic Matter through it. This will create a [Cell](entry://items/cell). \
  \
Like the Organic Matter, this has the entity's type attached.

Craft a [DNA Extractor](entry://blocks/dna_extractor), and process the Cell through it. This will create a [DNA Helix](entry://items/dna_helix), which carries an unknown Gene. \
  \
To find out what Gene it is, you'll need to process it through a [DNA Decryptor](entry://blocks/dna_decryptor).

Some entities have [#](5555ff)several Genes[#]() that they can give. This is a weighted choice, with some Genes being more common than others. \
  \
You can see the chance of each in JEI. \
  \
All DNA Helices have a chance of being [#](ff5555)Basic[#](), which contains no Gene. \
  \
This does not make it useless, however.

Now that you have some decrypted DNA Helices, you have to inject them into a [Plasmid](entry://items/plasmid). \
  \
This is done at the [Plasmid Infuser](entry://blocks/plasmid_infuser). \
  \
For more information on that, see the Plasmid's page, linked above.

Craft a [Syringe](entry://items/syringe), and use it to extract some of your own blood. \
  \
Pass it through a [Blood Purifier](entry://blocks/blood_purifier) to decontaminate it. \
  \
Then, you can combine it and the completed Plasmid in a [Plasmid Injector](entry://blocks/plasmid_injector) to add the Gene to the Syringe.

You can add as many Genes to the Syringe as you like. When you're ready, [#](5555ff)inject the blood back into yourself[#]() to gain all the Genes! \
  \
Be warned, some Genes may [#](ff5555)require other Genes[#]() to be able to be injected. Trying to inject them without the requisite Genes will result in dire consequences. \
  \
You can see what Genes are required in the Gene's Plasmid's JEI info page.
book.geneticsresequenced.guide.items.ant:
The [#](ff55ff)Anti-Field Orb[#]() allows you to [#](5555ff)temporarily disable certain Genes[#](). \
  \
Specifically, it disables the [Item Attraction Field](entry://genes/item_attraction_field) and [XP Attraction Field](entry://genes/xp_attraction_field) when enabled. \
  \
The [Anti-Field Block](entry://blocks/anti_field_block) functions similarly, but in block form.
The Anti-Field Orb can be toggled by right-clicking it while held.

An [#](ff55ff)Anti-Plasmid[#]() removes one unwanted Gene from its host. \
  \
Craft an empty Anti-Plasmid with a completed Plasmid to copy its Gene.
Add it to purified blood in the Plasmid Injector, then inject that blood into its owner.
book.geneticsresequenced.guide.items.cel:
[#](ff55ff)Cells[#]() are a recipe ingredient used in the creation of [DNA Helices](entry://items/dna_helix). \
  \
This is done in the [DNA Extractor](entry://blocks/dna_extractor).

Each entity has its own Cell, which can be processed into a [DNA Helix](entry://items/dna_helix) of the entity's type. \
  \
You can see the Cell's entity type in the item's tooltip.
book.geneticsresequenced.guide.items.des: All the items in the mod
book.geneticsresequenced.guide.items.dna:
[#](ff55ff)DNA Helices[#]() contain genetic information. This can be either in the form of a [Gene](category://genes), or an [#](5555ff)Entity[#](). \
  \
Freshly crafted, a DNA Helix contains only the Entity that the DNA came from.

This DNA Helix contains the genetic information of a [#](5555ff)Cow[#](), but the actual Gene it has is [#](ff5555)unknown[#](). To decrypt it, you'll need to pass it through a [DNA Decryptor](entry://blocks/dna_decryptor).
This DNA Helix has been decrypted, and now we can see it contains the [Milky](entry://genes/milky) Gene.
DNA Helices have a chance of being [#](5555ff)Basic[#](). This means that they [#](ff5555)don't contain any Gene[#](), but they can still contribute to [Plasmids](entry://items/plasmid).
book.geneticsresequenced.guide.items.dra:
The [#](ff55ff)Dragon Health Crystal[#]() is part of the [Ender Dragon Health](entry://genes/ender_dragon_health) Gene. \
  \
While you have that Gene, and while holding a Dragon Health Crystal, any incoming damage is negated and instead dealt to the Crystal.

A fresh Dragon Health Crystal has [#](5555ff)1,000 durability[#](). \
  \
Each half-heart deals 1 point of durability damage. \
  \
Only the first Crystal in your inventory is used. It can be repaired with Ghast Tears.
book.geneticsresequenced.guide.items.gen: The [#](ff55ff)Gene Checker[#](), as the name implies, is used to [#](5555ff)check what Genes an entity has[#]().
It shows both the target's current Genes and the Genes it can provide with their weights. If no entity is targeted, it checks you.
book.geneticsresequenced.guide.items.gmo:
A [#](ff55ff)GMO Cell[#]() already has a known Gene, skipping random DNA Decryption. \
  \
Make one from a typed Potion of Cell Growth or Mutation in a low-temperature Advanced Incubator. Each recipe has its own success chance.
Process it in a DNA Extractor to get a DNA Helix with its Gene already revealed. Recipe viewers show the available combinations.
book.geneticsresequenced.guide.items.met:
A [#](ff55ff)Metal Syringe[#]() extracts blood from the entity you target instead of yourself. \
  \
Only that blood's owner can receive its Genes. While filled, the owner glows through walls.
Purify contaminated blood, add completed Plasmids in a Plasmid Injector, then hold right-click on the blood's owner to inject it.
book.geneticsresequenced.guide.items.org:
[#](ff55ff)Organic Matter[#]() is a recipe ingredient used in the creation of [Cells](entry://items/cell). \
  \
This is done in the [Cell Analyzer](entry://blocks/cell_analyzer).

Each entity has its own Organic Matter, which can be processed into a [Cell](entry://items/cell) of the entity's type. \
  \
You can see the Organic Matter's entity type in the item's tooltip.
book.geneticsresequenced.guide.items.ove:
The [#](ff55ff)Overclocker[#]() can be inserted into most of the mod's machines to [#](5555ff)massively increase their speed[#](). \
  \
Each Overclocker doubles the speed, but increases the power draw by a quarter.
You can have [#](5555ff)up to 8 Overclockers[#]() in a machine.
book.geneticsresequenced.guide.items.pla:
[#](ff55ff)Plasmids[#]() are the vehicle that carries [Genes](category://genes). \
  \
Plasmids default as [#](ff5555)empty[#](), with no genetic information. \
  \
To begin, use a [Plasmid Infuser](entry://blocks/plasmid_infuser) to infuse a decrypted DNA Helix into them. \
  \
This will set the Plasmid's Gene.

Plasmids require a certain amount of [#](5555ff)Gene Points[#]() to be complete. \
  \
The amount of Gene Points required depends on the Plasmid's Gene. [#](5555ff)More advanced Genes cost more Points.[#]()

This Plasmid has been infused with the [Scare Creepers](entry://genes/scare_creepers) Gene. \
  \
Notice, however, that it [#](ff5555)only contains 1 Gene Point[#](). \
  \
Infusing more DNA Helices of the same Gene will add +2 Points each, while Basic Genes will add +1 each.

Once it's reached its maximum Gene Points required, the Plasmid will be marked [#](5555ff)complete[#]()! \
  \
That means it's ready to be injected into a Syringe at the [Plasmid Injector](entry://blocks/plasmid_injector).
book.geneticsresequenced.guide.items.pot:
The [#](ff55ff)Potion of Mutation[#]() is used to craft [Genetically Modified Cells](entry://items/potion_of_cell_growth#2) that are set to [#](5555ff)mutation Genes[#](). \
  \
Mutation Genes are effectively just [#](5555ff)more powerful[#]() Genes, and generally [#](ff5555)require other Genes[#]().

[#](ff55ff)Potions of Cell Growth[#](), like Organic Substrate, has no effect when imbibed. It's more of a crafting ingredient than a potion. \
  \
These recipes allow you to [#](5555ff)improve your odds of getting certain rare Genes[#]().
A [Cell](entry://items/cell) can be brewed into the Potion of Cell Growth to [#](5555ff)set the Potion to the Cell's entity type[#]().

From there, certain entity types have recipes to make [#](ff55ff)Genetically Modified Cells[#](), which are guaranteed to give a specific Gene. \
  \
However, there's a catch. They can _only_ be crafted in an [Advanced Incubator](entry://blocks/incubator_advanced) at low temperature, and there's [#](ff5555)a chance of failure[#]().

A low-temperature Advanced Incubator takes a very long time, but can be accelerated using Overclockers. \
  \
Unfortunately, [#](ff5555)Overclockers lower your chances[#]() of success. [#](5555ff)Chorus Fruits[#]() increase it back, though! \
  \
Process the GM Cell through a [DNA Extractor](entry://blocks/dna_extractor) to get the set Helix.

[#](ff55ff)Organic Substrate[#]() is the first of the mod's potions. \
  \
Organic Substrate has no effect when drunk, but is used in some recipes. \
  \
If a [Cell](entry://items/cell) is brewed into Organic Substrate, the Substrate is replaced with a copy of the Cell. Given that you can have 3 Potions in a single brew, this allows you to triple Cells, if needed.

Additionally, Organic Substrate is used to brew [Potions of Cell Growth](entry://items/potion_of_cell_growth). \
  \
You may prefer to use the [Incubator](entry://blocks/incubator) to brew these recipes, rather than the Brewing Stand.
[#](ff55ff)Panacea[#]() is a simple potion: It cures all negative effects, and [#](5555ff)removes all negative Genes[#]().
Sure, you could do the same with a Bucket of Milk and an Anti-Plasmid, but this is much more convenient, sometimes, maybe.

[#](ff55ff)Viral Agents[#]() are the final crafting potion of the mod. They are used to craft [negative Genes](category://genes/negative), which are generally just any Gene that's harmful. \
  \
Negative Genes are [#](5555ff)always lost on death[#](), regardless of config setting. Additionally, there's a config to prevent players from even being able to _get_ negative Genes in the first place.
Virus Cultivation recipes can be crafted in the Brewing Stand or in either Incubator.
A [#](ff55ff)Potion of Zombify Villager[#]() does right what it says on the tin: it turns Villagers into Zombie Villagers.
Obviously, it's best utilized in Splash form.
book.geneticsresequenced.guide.items.scr:
The [#](ff55ff)Scraper[#]() is used to get [Organic Matter](entry://items/organic_matter) from mobs. \
  \
Right-click a mob to scrape it, or sneak and right-click empty air to scrape yourself. Scraping damages and may anger the target.
Scrapers can be enchanted with [#](5555ff)Delicate Touch[#](), which prevents damaging and angering entities.
book.geneticsresequenced.guide.items.syr:
The [#](ff55ff)Syringe[#]() is used to [#](5555ff)extract and inject blood[#](). Simply hold right-click, and the process will end automatically. \
  \
The reason you'd _want_ to extract blood is that that's what carries completed [Plasmids](entry://items/plasmid) back into your body.

When you extract blood, it'll be [#](ff5555)contaminated[#](). You'll need to clean it up in the [Blood Purifier](entry://blocks/blood_purifier) before it can be used. \
  \
Plasmids are added in the [Plasmid Injector](entry://blocks/plasmid_injector).

You can also use the [#](ff55ff)Metal Syringe[#](), which targets others instead of yourself! \
  \
This is how you would give Genes to entities.

info.gene.geneticsresequenced.basic:
The most basic Gene, which does nothing, and can't even be injected.

It can be used as a crafting ingredient, as it's worth 1 DNA Point in the Plasmid Infuser.

info.gene.geneticsresequenced.bountiful: Mobs with this Gene will drop loot as if they were killed with Looting one level higher than it was.
info.gene.geneticsresequenced.bountiful_: Mobs with this Gene will drop loot as if they were killed with Looting two levels higher than it was.

Your chat messages are automatically read by the narrator (within 64 blocks).

Can be disabled in the client config.
info.gene.geneticsresequenced.chilling: Has a chance of inflicting freezing damage on hit.

info.gene.geneticsresequenced.claws_2: Doubles the chances of inflicting Bleeding on hit.

(UwU-fies your outgoing chat messages, and sets your language to LOLCAT)
